messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 40):
"""
We undertake to file the product afresh if there is any variation in the product filed above. Signature of the Chief Compliance Officer Place Date: Name and Counter Signature of the principal officer along with name, and Company’s seal. Annexure-5 Information to be furnished to IRDAI on Withdrawal of Health Insurance Products or Add-ons or Riders Offered by Life or Health or General Insurers GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS: (a) Insurers shall use the specified form for filing information about withdrawal of existing Health Insurance products or Add-ons or Riders. Format shall be used separately for each Product or Add-on or Rider. (b) All items in the Form must be furnished with the relevant details. (c) The form shall be filed within 30 days from the date of withdrawing the product. FORM:
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"Within how many days must an insurer file the withdrawal form for a health insurance product?","answer":"The insurer must file the form within 30 days from the date of withdrawing the product.","facts":["The form shall be filed within 30 days from the date of withdrawing the product"]},{"question":"Who must sign the product filing form when a variation occurs?","answer":"The Chief Compliance Officer must sign the product filing form, and the principal officer must also sign with the company’s seal.","facts":["We undertake to file the product afresh if there is any variation in the product filed above.","Signature of the Chief Compliance Officer Place Date: Name and Counter Signature of the principal officer along with name, and Company’s seal"]}]}
